aliases: Wire Free (Battery) 2K Spotlight Camera with 2-Way Audio and Audio Alerts and Siren

power.method: rechargeable battery (2 included, holds up to 4)

features: wire-free rechargeable battery (2 included, up to 4)
microSD or Night Owl recorder storage

frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).

release_notes: Night Owl CAM-BWNIP4-BU: a wire-free (battery) 2K spotlight camera with 60 ft night vision, a 105 view, two-way audio, alerts and a siren; holds up to four rechargeable batteries. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted, form-factor from the product listing.
